name: Maximus (MMS)
teaser: The $700 to $800 million free cash flow guide includes about $330 million of delayed collections. Normalized owner cash flow is $417 million, a 12.9% yield, but Agile Defense and the lost VA incentive change the company. Hold at $61.17.
llms: Maximus is a U.S. government services contractor (Medicaid and benefits programs, VA medical exams, federal technology) that closed the $660 million Agile Defense acquisition on November 18, 2026. Fiscal 2027 free cash flow is guided at $700 to $800 million, but about $330 million is catch-up of delayed collections; my normalized owner free cash flow is $417 million, a 12.9% yield. Bear $49.04, Base $79.00, Bull $119.38. Verdict Hold at $61.17, maximum buy price $45.43.
